kpis.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats) AS registered_players,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_value) AS active_players,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_spins) AS spins,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_sessions) AS sessions,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(bet_amount), 0) FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_spins) AS turnover,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(bet_amount - win_amount), 0) FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_spins) AS ggr,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(win_amount) / SUM(bet_amount), 4) FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_spins) AS rtp

channels.sql:
SELECT acquisition_channel, registered_players, active_players, activation_rate,
       ggr, ggr_per_registered_player, hold_rate
FROM workspace.igaming.gold_channel_performance
ORDER BY ggr_per_registered_player DESC

segments.sql:
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS players,
       ROUND(SUM(turnover), 0) AS turnover,
       ROUND(SUM(ggr), 0) AS ggr,
       ROUND(SUM(ggr) / SUM(SUM(ggr)) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_ggr
FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_value
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY ggr DESC

pareto.sql:
SELECT ROUND(decile / 10.0, 1) AS top_share_of_players,
       ROUND(SUM(SUM(turnover)) OVER (ORDER BY decile) / SUM(SUM(turnover)) OVER (), 4) AS cumulative_share_of_turnover
FROM (
  SELECT turnover, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY turnover DESC) AS decile
  FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_value
)
GROUP BY decile
ORDER BY decile

net_winners.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_players,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ggr < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS net_winners,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ggr < 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS net_winner_share
FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_value

top_vip.sql:
SELECT player_id, acquisition_channel, country, turnover, ggr, sessions
FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats
WHERE segment = 'VIP'
ORDER BY turnover DESC
LIMIT 10

risk_levels.sql:
SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS players
FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'High' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

risk_flags.sql:
SELECT 'Geo mismatch' AS flag, SUM(geo_mismatch) AS sessions FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions
UNION ALL SELECT 'Long session', SUM(flag_long_session) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions
UNION ALL SELECT 'High pace', SUM(flag_high_pace) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions
UNION ALL SELECT 'High bet', SUM(flag_high_bet) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions
UNION ALL SELECT 'Shared device', SUM(flag_shared_device) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions
UNION ALL SELECT 'Shared IP', SUM(flag_shared_ip) FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions

monthly.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(bet_amount), 0) AS turnover,
       ROUND(SUM(bet_amount - win_amount), 0) AS ggr,
       COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS active_players
FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_spins
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ts)
ORDER BY month

volatility.sql:
SELECT slot_volatility, COUNT(*) AS spins,
       ROUND(SUM(bet_amount), 0) AS turnover,
       ROUND(SUM(bet_amount - win_amount), 0) AS ggr,
       ROUND(SUM(win_amount) / SUM(bet_amount), 4) AS rtp
FROM workspace.igaming.bronze_spins
GROUP BY slot_volatility
ORDER BY turnover DESC

details.question: Who are the 10 players with the highest turnover?
details.sql: SELECT player_id, turnover FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats ORDER BY turnover DESC LIMIT 10

details.question: Which acquisition channel generates the most revenue?
details.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, ggr FROM workspace.igaming.gold_channel_performance ORDER BY ggr DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: How many players are there in each segment?
details.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS players FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats GROUP BY segment LIMIT 100

details.question: What is the total gross gaming revenue?
details.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ggr), 2) AS total_ggr FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats LIMIT 100

details.question: How many sessions have a high risk level?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions WHERE risk_level = 'High' LIMIT 100

details.question: What is the average turnover of VIP players?
details.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(turnover), 2) AS avg_turnover FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats WHERE segment = 'VIP' LIMIT 100

details.question: How many players use each device type?
details.sql: SELECT device_pref, COUNT(*) AS players FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats GROUP BY device_pref LIMIT 100

details.question: Which channel has the best activation rate?
details.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, activation_rate FROM workspace.igaming.gold_channel_performance ORDER BY activation_rate DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: How many high value players are at risk of leaving?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats WHERE segment = 'At risk (high value)' LIMIT 100

details.question: What share of sessions have a geo mismatch?
details.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(geo_mismatch), 4) AS rate FROM workspace.igaming.gold_risk_sessions LIMIT 100

details.question: Which channel earns the least per registered player?
details.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, ggr_per_registered_player FROM workspace.igaming.gold_channel_performance ORDER BY ggr_per_registered_player ASC LIMIT 1

details.question: How many players bought a feature more than 50 times?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats WHERE feature_buys > 50 LIMIT 100

details.question: How many registered players never played?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats WHERE segment = 'No activity' LIMIT 100

details.question: What is the average number of sessions of a Champion?
details.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(sessions), 2) AS avg_sessions FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats WHERE segment = 'Champion' LIMIT 100

details.question: What is the total turnover by operating system?
details.sql: SELECT os, ROUND(SUM(turnover), 2) AS turnover FROM workspace.igaming.gold_player_stats GROUP BY os LIMIT 100
